report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, and an INFO 200 request log. The only anomaly is a single gateway->inventory trace span at 1001ms with ERROR status, which is insufficient to establish any bounded root cause. No inventory, order, redis, or postgres telemetry is available, so candidates cannot be scoped. Handing off for the missing evidence.
missing_evidence: Gateway error-rate and p95 latency time series for the alert window to confirm the alert is real
Inventory service traces/metrics/logs to explain the 1001ms ERROR span on gateway->inventory
Order service telemetry (gateway->order->inventory path) to localize the failing hop
Redis telemetry for inventory dependency to test redis-timeout
Postgres/payment telemetry to rule out db-pool-exhaustion and other downstream causes
